hook.hook: Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

captions.instagram:
Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

I love growing garlic because it takes very little attention once it is in the ground. If you want to know how to grow garlic in the UK, just plant the largest outer cloves in well-drained soil. Make sure you lift the bulbs when the lower leaves turn yellow and brown.

Do not store raw garlic in oil at room temperature, as there is a risk of botulism.

Check your local frost dates.

captions.instagram:
Stop buying blackberry. Planting your own this November

Here is how to grow blackberry UK plants in a small garden. Plant bare-root or potted canes between November and March in fertile soil. Tie new canes to one side of your wires and fruiting canes to the other. I open freeze my picked berries on a tray so none go to waste.

Check your local frost dates.
